source.title: Green Iron Bracers
source.objective:
ProgressI'm working on a new costume, for when I have my own booth as the strongest woman alive!  Right now I'm looking for some bracers I can wear.  They can't cover much because people want to see my muscles, but I still want to flash a little color, you know?

How about green iron bracers, <name>?  Can you make me green iron bracers?  If you can, then I have a whole bunch of Darkmoon Faire tickets for you.
source.completion:
Yes!  These are exactly what I need!  Such a lovely color, and they still leave my arms bare so you can see how strong they are!  Perfect!

Here you are, <name>.  Here are your tickets - enjoy!
